query: SELECT language_id, COUNT(*) AS samples, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE compile_time IS NULL) AS warm, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('sandbox_failure','internal_error')) AS faults, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY wall_time) AS p50_wall, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY wall_time) AS p95_wall FROM submissions WHERE finished_at IS NOT NULL AND finished_at > NOW() - ($1 || ' minutes')::interval GROUP BY language_id
